description: Planet is a commercial radio-frequency planning and optimisation platform used by mobile operators to plan and optimise 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G networks. It combines propagation prediction, coverage and capacity analysis, neighbour and frequency planning, automatic optimisation and the analysis of drive-test and network measurement data within a GIS environment, and a cloud edition, VistaPlan Go (formerly Planet Cloud), offers the planning functions as a service. It is produced by Infovista, a French network intelligence software company whose portfolio also includes the TEMS testing tools, for operators and vendors that need to roll out and densify radio networks. Coverage: any country or region for which terrain, clutter and building data are loaded; resolution follows the planning rasters. Format and access: licensed desktop software and a software-as-a-service cloud edition; paid, with prices on request. Caveats: proprietary; results rely on calibrated propagation models and operator site data that are not public; product names change frequently. Simulation uses: coverage and hazard exposure of mobile networks, capacity planning and optimisation, and resilience analysis of site outages. Related records: Forsk Atoll is the main competitor, Wireless InSite and Sionna provide ray-traced propagation, and OpenCelliD gives public site locations.
